finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Both interval methods exclude the useful margin against base, pooled, donor and uniform; all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantages are excluded under writer resampling but remain unresolved under crossed resampling. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with all residual intervals including zero. Raw sums exclude useful base and pooled advantage under both methods and useful donor advantage under writer resampling; donor uncertainty remains only under crossed resampling. All raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Mixed human/model provenance, sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, epoch/seed/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
